summary: Workflow-sized tasks depend on trustworthy gates and regression checks, and they complement delivery policies that replace manual diff review with structured evidence.

items.text: Use validated system signals to judge the combined result; a large workflow without trustworthy evidence only enlarges the opaque change surface.
Require one end-to-end gate that protects previously passing behavior across all slices before treating them as a single workflow-sized delivery.
If pull-request diff reading is removed, keep the workflow's combined change reviewable through deterministic gates, structured verdicts and per-slice evidence.
